welcome.heading: Welcome to Casa Dossier
welcome.slide1Body: The dashboard shows your real-time Health Score, overdue maintenance tasks, tracked assets by system, and recent service activity — all in one place.
welcome.slide1Tip: Your Health Score updates automatically as you log work and complete tasks.
welcome.slide2Body: Add your HVAC, roof, water heater, kitchen appliances, and more. Store model numbers, serial numbers, warranties, and purchase dates in one searchable place.
welcome.slide2Tip: Each asset gets its own health score and maintenance timeline.
welcome.slide3Title: A Paper Trail for Every Repair
welcome.slide3Body: Log every service call, repair, and upgrade. Record the contractor, cost, and notes — and your home builds a verified history that protects your investment.
welcome.slide3Tip: Service records are linked to individual assets so history follows each system.
welcome.slide4Body: The AI Scout analyzed your home's age, region, and climate to generate a personalized Whole-Home Stewardship Plan — with seasonal tasks, due dates, and DIY tips.
welcome.slide4Tip: You can re-run the Scout anytime to refresh your plan as your home changes.
welcome.slide5Body: When it's time to sell, generate a complete Home Dossier Report — a verifiable record of every repair, appliance, and upgrade that protects value and impresses buyers.
welcome.slide5Tip: Reports can be shared as a link or downloaded as a PDF.

landing.tagline: The Home Maintenance OS for Modern Homeowners
landing.heroSubtitle: Casa Dossier is the Carfax for homes — a living record of every repair, appliance, upgrade, and service visit. Know your home. Protect your investment. Transfer your history.
landing.noCreditCard: No credit card required · Demo needs no login
landing.featuresSectionTitle: Everything your home needs in one place
landing.featuresSectionSubtitle: Built for homeowners who care about protecting their biggest asset.
landing.benefit1: Increase resale value with a documented home history
landing.benefit2: Never miss a warranty claim again
landing.benefit3: Know your replacement costs before they surprise you
landing.benefit4: Transfer your complete home record to the next owner
landing.feature1Desc: Every repair, upgrade, and service visit logged and searchable — like a Carfax report but for your home.
landing.feature2Desc: Scan any appliance data tag and our AI instantly generates a personalized maintenance schedule based on your exact model.
landing.feature3Desc: Know what's coming. See upcoming replacement costs and plan your home investment years in advance.
landing.feature4Desc: Generate a printable, verified record of your home — perfect for home sales, insurance claims, or refinancing.
landing.feature5Desc: Track every appliance, system, and fixture with model numbers, serial numbers, warranties, and service records.
landing.feature6Desc: Get a real-time grade on your home's condition and a clear improvement plan to protect your biggest investment.
landing.prosDesc: When you post a job through Casa Dossier, pros see your home's full asset profile before they ever accept the request — so they show up with the right tools and the right parts.
landing.tech1Detail: The exact make, model, and serial number of every appliance — so techs order the right part before they knock.
landing.tech2Detail: Every past repair, inspection, and part replacement. No more explaining what happened two visits ago.
landing.tech3Detail: Install date, warranty status, known issues, and notes — all visible to the pro when they accept the job.
landing.quoteText: The technician came with the right part
landing.quoteDetail: He already knew it was a 2019 Carrier with the bad capacitor. Didn't even have to explain anything.
landing.ctaTitle: Start your home's permanent record today
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join homeowners who are taking control of their home's history, health, and value.
